messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: PROD - migration job failing during release rollout (svc-payments). Error rate spike > 8% across region us-west-2. See logs below. Threading to #incidents and paging oncall.

sara: I'm on it, paging db-eng and deploy. Initial quick check: canary hosts are failing health checks. rolling back canary to previous revision.

miguel: joining. what's the error from the migration job? paste logs pls.

sara: logs:
```
2026-03-14T02:45:12Z migration_runner ERROR Failed applying step 0007_add_user_profile: ERROR: column "user_profile" does not exist
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/migrations/runner.py", line 87, in apply
    cur.execute(sql)
psycopg2.errors.UndefinedColumn: column \"user_profile\" does not exist
```
It looks like the migration expects a column that older read services still reference? unclear.

alex: :thinking_face: That error usually comes from a downgrade happening while code still assumes the new column. Which migration was in this release? 0007 is additive though, weird.

nina: Canary vm: canary-1, canary-2 show 502s on write path. Read-only traffic still okay. Customer-facing payments are failing for a small % of users — CS flagged 3 customers so far.

paul: I'm seeing a schema mismatch in the schema registry diff: model payments.v2 references user_profile in SELECTs. Looks like the deploy included code that touched DB before migration completed.

db-eng: jumping in. Likely root cause: deployment concurrency + migration ordering. We run migration as post-deploy hook but traffic-steering promoted instances before migration finished on DB. Need to kill feature flag that enables new payments path.

sara: executing kill-switch for feature flag `payments_v2` now: `ffctl toggle payments_v2 off --env=prod`

deploy-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by sara: `redwood-cli release rollback --service svc-payments --to-revision=2026-03-13_22` (started)

miguel: confirming kill-switch applied. Observability: error rate dropping on canaries but not fully recovered on some AZs.

ops-lead: Is DB migration still running? Any stuck locks?

db-eng: checked migrations process: migration job 0007 stuck waiting on lock from a long-running transaction on `orders` table. That transaction belongs to svc-payments instance id `svc-payments-7f9` which is still at new code. We need to force-terminate that session.

paul: I can drain and restart that pod to release the transaction. Will do `kubectl delete pod svc-payments-7f9 -n prod` and scale down to prevent immediate rollout.

sara: Please wait — we need coordinated steps: 1) ensure rollback rollout is in progress 2) terminate lingering pod 3) confirm migration job completes or aborts safely. Follow runbook link: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/db-migrations

alex: I'm on the rollback watch. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/svc-payments -n prod --to-revision=2026-03-13_22` started. Canary groups being restored to previous replica set.

nina: CS report: two customers saw failed payments flow; we've provided workaround and are notifying them. Customer-success-bot posted initial incident message to customers impacted list.

customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers A123 and B456. Draft message posted to #customer-comms for review.

deploy-bot: Rollback canary completed: canary-1 healthy, canary-2 healthy. Promoting rollback to 50% of traffic.

miguel: I've deleted pod svc-payments-7f9 to release the lock. DB sessions list shows the long transaction is gone.

db-eng: re-running migration job in dry-run mode to validate: `python manage.py migrate --fake-check` — this passes but the real migration initially failed due to ordering. We will hold migrations until full rollback completes.

ops-lead: Good. Can we confirm overall customer impact is contained? Any other services affected?

sara: Monitoring: service error rate back to baseline for 75% of instances; a few AZs still showing 500s but trending down. No downstream services beyond payments observed. CS will send status update in 10m.

paul: Posting quick mitigation summary for handoff: - Kill-switch toggled for payments_v2 - Rollback initiated and canaries restored - Lingering pod terminated to release DB lock - Migration job paused until postmortem - Notifying customers and setting bridge

miguel: Taking over incident from here. I'll lead the recovery and coordinate postmortem. I'm recording timeline and will escalate to SRE if rollbacks don't finish in next 15m.

sara: thanks — handing off. I'm on standby for any DB assistance.

miguel: Action items for immediate next 30m: 1) Confirm rollback fully rolled out to prod 2) Verify no orphaned DB transactions 3) Run migration pre-checks in non-prod and prepare a safe migration plan (zero-downtime) 4) Draft incident summary for postmortem; owners: db-eng + svc-payments

db-eng: We'll prepare a migration runbook change: ensure migrations are gate-kept by a release controller and apply in a pre-deploy step or use delayed feature flag. Add explicit ABORT-ON-LOCK policy.

customer-success-bot: CS updated affected customers with status: "We have rolled back the recent payments update and are verifying stability. We will follow up after investigation." 

miguel: marking incident as mitigation-in-progress. Will update every 10 minutes until resolved. If anything degrades, re-ping @oncall.

sara: final note before I step out: recommend a coordinated release window and a pre-release DB checklist for all teams. Put action item into backlog: ISSUE-4221.

nina: copying this thread to #postmortems once we have a summary.

miguel: End of active mitigation log for now. Next update at 2026-03-14T03:15Z. :white_check_mark:
